# cline-mcp

MCP server wrapping the Cline SDK.
- [README.md](README.md) — full docs
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) — complete reference

## Tools
- `agent_run(prompt, model?, provider?)` — one-shot agent
- `agent_session_start(prompt)` — background session
- `agent_session_status(session_id)` — check session
- `agent_session_stop(session_id)` — stop session
- `agent_session_list()` — list sessions
- `agent_schedule_create(name, cron, prompt)` — schedule agent
- `agent_schedule_list()` — list schedules
- `agent_schedule_delete(name)` — delete schedule
- `agent_team_run(goal)` — multi-agent team

## Port
11096 (MCP HTTP, reserved)
